title: Employees Provident Fund
summary: EPF नेपालमा retirement savings र long-term financial security दिने government-backed provident fund system हो।
originalContent: Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Nepal is a trusted government-managed social security organization ensuring financial security and retirement savings for employees across public and private sectors. Karmachari Sanchaya Kosh (Employees Provident Fund – EPF) is a statutory institution established under the Employees Provident Fund Act, 2019, mandated to manage the Provident Fund (PF) and Contributory Pension Fund system in Nepal. EPF administers retirement savings for employees working in the government, public enterprises and private sector. As a trustee institution, EPF ensures long-term financial security for its members through systematic savings and investment. In addition to managing Provident Fund contributions, EPF has been entrusted with implementing the Contributory Pension Scheme for federal government and Public sector employees , in accordance with the Pension Fund Act, 2075. Explore the locations and services offered by the Employees Provident Fund across Nepal. Check out our latest app for our contributors. EPF App contains all the information and activities on the palm of your hands for the best efficiency and convenience.

originalContent: The Employees Provident Fund (EPF) of Nepal offers a robust and thoughtfully designed portfolio of social security schemes that uphold the dignity and financial protection of its contributors. With a firm commitment to safeguarding members against life’s uncertainties, EPF provides essential support during times of medical need, maternity, accidents, and bereavement. These welfare provisions reflect a deep understanding of the social and economic realities faced by working individuals and their families. By ensuring timely assistance and financial relief through compassionate and structured programs, EPF reinforces its role as a trusted institution in the nation’s social protection landscape. These initiatives not only ease the burden during critical moments but also affirm EPF’s broader mission—to enhance the resilience and well-being of Nepal’s workforce through sustainable and inclusive security mechanisms.

title: EPF Nepal
summary: EPF नेपालमा retirement savings र long-term financial security दिने government-backed provident fund system हो।
originalContent: The Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Nepal serves as a vital retirement savings mechanism for employees across government, public enterprises, and private sectors. Established under the Employee Provident Fund Act, 2019 (1962), the EPF ensures financial security for its members through systematic savings and interest accrual. 10% amount deducted from contributor’s monthly salary and same amount added by the employer will be deposited in an account. EPF manages the deposit and returns the interest and profit to the concerned employee after his/her retirement or detachment from the office due to any reason. The EPF offers competitive interest rates on the accumulated funds. For instance, in the fiscal year 2082/83, contributors received an interest rate of 4.25%, with an additional 1% added at the end of the year, totaling 5.25%. Interest is calculated monthly but credited annually, enhancing the growth of members’ savings. The EPF invests the pooled funds in various sectors, including infrastructure and hydroelectric projects, aiming to generate stable returns. Annually, the EPF provides contributors with detailed statements outlining monthly contributions, interest earned, and the total balance, ensuring transparency and trust in fund management. Through these mechanisms, the EPF Nepal not only facilitates disciplined savings among employees but also ensures the growth and security of their retirement funds.

originalContent: The basic intention behind the operation of this scheme is to facilitate the organizations long-term liabilities by fully funding it. In doing so, the organizations are relieved from the heavy financial burden that they might posses in the near future. Under this scheme, employee’s liabilities towards the organizations are deposited. The employees are assured for their benefits at the time of retirement or post-retirement since the equivalent amount of the liabilities are funded and separated from the institutions. And thus the segregated amount is deposited in CIT. Organizations and Institutions can deposit such funds in CIT when the liabilities are created in the account of the organizations.This scheme also operates as a retirement scheme.

title: कर्मचारी बचतबृद्दि स्विकृत अवकाश काेष
summary: नेपालको regulated financial support scheme।
originalContent: Employees Saving Growth Retirement Scheme is one of the major schemes introduced to the employees. A certain amount of fund is deducted from the salary and is deposited under this scheme in a monthly basis. Every offices or organization deposits the deducted amount to the designated collection center. The branches of Commercial Banks and Nepal Rastra Bank are used as a designated collection centers in different parts of the countries. This is a fully voluntary scheme. This scheme is based on Defined Contributory Fully Funded and Individual Account Based System. This scheme is supposed to be helpful in supporting pension reform process, replacing the existing pay-as-you-go government pension system. This scheme is also expected to be helpful in expanding the coverage of Retirement Benefits. Participant under this scheme can enjoy the privilege of tax deduction facility upto the limit of contribution made or 33 percent of total remuneration in retirement schemes.

summary: CIT long-term saving, retirement planning र secure investment platform हो।
originalContent: CIT is providing buyback facilities at its own premises to facilitate for liquidity of the units. CIT operates this scheme under the investment trust concept. A separate trust committee has been formed to look after the policy matters and operational aspects, which consists expert representation also from outside the organization. In addition CIT is operating its piloting product (Citizen Unit Scheme) from South Korea on 23-25 December 2017 with support of International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD,www.ifad.org) . On 12 April 2017, for this venture CIT hired Sunrise Bank Ltd as an agent for remitting collection money of unit holders from South korea to Nepal. However, CIT aims to collect fund in foreign currency, therefore, CIT send proposal to central bank of Nepal for approval of conducting foreign curreny account in foreign banks. In accordance with the project mandated by Ministry of Finance(GON) ,CIT has made its saving and investment product by receiving feedback from Product Development Workshop on 11-12 November 2016 with technical consulting supported by ACCESS Advisory ( a consulting firm that has been supporting financial inclusion and remittance building initiatives through technical service assistance to financial service providers being hired by IFAD ). This is the first stepping stone for CIT for collecting fund from Diaspora Nepali citizen.

title: नागरिक पेन्सन योजना
summary: CIT long-term saving, retirement planning र secure investment platform हो।
originalContent: Citizen Investment Trust, Citizen Pension Scheme has been operating its plan since 2019. This scheme is operating under Citizen Investment Trust Act, 1991. Under this Act, Citizen Investment Trust Management By laws 1992 provides right to operate pension plans so Citizen Investment Trust issued Citizen Pension Scheme Operation Directives, 2019 to operate the Pension Scheme. This scheme aimed at encouraging the general public voluntary involvement in social security for the future. It helps saving and mobilize such savings for the economic development of the country. It provides social security benefits, such as providing regular pensions to participants as well as their spouse after a specified age and contribution period. It is also planned to provide various other social and economic facilities to the participants. According to the Citizen Pension Scheme's rule, contributors can contribute minimum monthly NPR 500 as monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly basis. After age of 60 and minimum contribution of 15 years the contributor will be only able to eligible for receiving pension amount. If any contributor unable to contribute 15 years regular basis due to age, s/he can contribute at lump sum amount calculating minimum monthly NPR 500. After eligible for pension plan, contributors will be receiving monthly pension amount until his/her death. After contributor's death, pension plan will be transferred to his/her spouse. After spouse death, the rest of fund will be able to withdraw by his legal nominees. For more details, please visit our official website www.nlk.org.np/Citizen Pension Scheme and study published documents (Articles, Videos, Interviews etc.) For any queries, we would welcome in our official email: citpension@gmail.com / citpension@nlk.org.np.

title: राष्ट्रसेवक कर्मचारीको सावधिक जीवन बीमा कोष
summary: CIT long-term saving, retirement planning र secure investment platform हो।
originalContent: To minimize the financial risk to the dependent of government employees caused by their death and to secure their retirement life, on approval of Nepal Government Citizen investment Trust has been running the insurance fund project since Nepali calendar year 2062/63.It is mandatory to all Government Employees to contribute Rs. 400 from their monthly salary and the same amount Rs. 400 is added up by Nepal Government as insurance premium to the Insurance Fund. Citizen Investment Trust has facilitating to insured the general life insurance of insured sum Rs. 2,00,000 for twenty years life from insurance fund and has providing the insurance benefit as mentioned on the Civil Service Act 2049 (Sec.40.a). Two years after the introduce of government employees insurance fund , since Nepali calendar year 2064/65 Citizen Investment Trust has been running the Teacher Insurance Fund Project under mutual agreement with Nepal Government Ministry of Education. The objective of the project is to minimize the financial risk to the dependent of teachers caused by their death and to secure their retirement life. It is mandatory to all Community School Teachers to contribute Rs. 400 from their monthly salary and the same amount Rs. 400 is added up by Nepal Government as insurance premium to the Insurance Fund. Citizen Investment Trust has facilitating to insured the life insurance of insured sum Rs. 200,000 for twenty years life from insurance fund. It is mandatory to all Nepal Army employees to contribute Rs. 400 from their monthly salary and the same amount Rs. 400 is added up as insurance premium to the Insurance Fund. It is mandatory to all Nepal police employees to contribute Rs. 400 from their monthly salary and the same amount Rs. 400 is added up as insurance premium to the Insurance Fund. It is mandatory to all armed police force employees to contribute Rs. 400 from their monthly salary and the same amount Rs. 400 is added up as insurance premium to the Insurance Fund

originalContent: This is also a kind of retirement schemes. Institutions can participate in this scheme making their long-term liabilities other than pensions / gratuities funds funded. The objectives of this scheme are to facilitate institutions to make their liabilities like welfare funds, Insurance funds and similar nature of other funds fully funded. The procedures for participation and operation are the same to the Pension / Gratuity Schemes. Investor’s Account Schemes are carried out under two different models. The first model is operated under the approach of retirement schemes. The another model operates under only the concept of Investment Trust i.e. ‘Portfolio Management Services’. However both the schemes are conducted according to investment trust concept. CIT charges a minimum amount of service charge as management fee on the management of the funds.
